sources.name: Beinlich_galley_FB2.pdf
sources.source_type: local author proof; provenance type retained, not mislabelled final PDF

figure_findings.S13: Awake and isoflurane state comparison, panels A-G, N=7 mice; A describes awake recording followed by recording under isoflurane; C/D display separate condition traces over 0-600 s. Does not establish an induction event inside each selected source file.
figure_findings.Figure4: KX, quiet awake and mobile states; the selected awake files are mapped to Fig. 4 in the source workbook. Figure labels do not identify individual animals; identities come from the workbook/manifest.
figure_findings.caption_issue: S13 C/D text mentions normoxia-to-hyperoxia, inconsistent with S13 title, design, labels and main-text isoflurane discussion. Preserve as an apparent caption error; do not infer a gas transition.
figure_findings.duration_limit: S13 describes ten-minute awake observation and displays 600 s. The four FB local sources have 1200 frames and the four M sources 600; exact historical segment/aggregation is not established by the caption. Do not silently truncate current sources.

user_clarification: If iso has not been applied during the recording there was a baseline established before but not measured.

interpretation.C02_design: Separate awake and established-isoflurane state recordings; awake-first sequence.
interpretation.pre_recording_state_establishment: Established before recording and unmeasured for files without intra-recording application, per user clarification.
interpretation.duration_status: not_measured; not required to recover an intra-file baseline for this state comparison
interpretation.distinguish_awake_control: A separate measured awake control recording exists; the unmeasured state-establishment interval is a different item.
interpretation.claims: State comparison only; no induction kinetics, wash-in latency or time-since-dose result without measured timing.

supersedes: Earlier requests to recover/confirm a numeric stabilization duration as a prerequisite for these separate-state C02 recordings. Preserve prior audit records as dated history; use this overlay for current review.
remaining_requirements: comparison-specific exposure choice; distinguish reproduction of published 600-s plot from reanalysis of full sources
